svg.aria-label: The decision matrix, filled in. Age out: near-zero downtime, a partial way back since the old side stays, months to years, two systems to run, the best fit for optimization; risks are the seams across the cutoff, an archive nobody retires, two stacks. Dump and restore: a planned window, a free way back until writes open, one window, the lowest ops load, lift first and remodel later; risks are a window overrun, quiet type drift, no free way back later. Blue/green: near-zero downtime, a reverse sync, weeks, the highest ops load, optimize during the move behind blue's shape; risks are a short oplog window, split brain at the flip, lag that freezes writes
